create.title: Hard-M1 t=1 rho-large P2 common-cell allocation commutator sector
create.statement_tex: Fix the exact accepted hard-M1 original-t=1 rho-large physical source N=dm, N+r=d'm', its Round-192 core, every literal endpoint and zero-extension field, both primitive orientations, both T branches, all anchor/Fourier copies, and one outer real part. Put g=(d,d'), d=g alpha, d'=g beta, D_L=ceil(sqrt L), and P_2=1_(|d-gm|<=D_L)1_(|d'-gm'|>D_L). On P_0=P_2 1_((m,beta)=1)1_(chi_4(alpha m)=-1), define C_lit by equality of the explicit arithmetic/support/sharp-branch code at the two lower allocations (m,g alpha) and (alpha,gm), with a dead state determined only by the named arithmetic, support, and zero-extension predicates and with coefficient values, rho_N, eta_L and smooth-factor values excluded. Put P_cc=P_0 C_lit; no nonemptiness, density, nonvanishing or mass is asserted. The lower swap (g alpha,m,g beta,m')->(gm,alpha,g beta,m') preserves products, shift, physical defects, common scalar and recomputed gcd g, reverses the character, and gives the actual lower difference lambda_N(g alpha)-lambda_N(gm). On a common live code the exact product rule has separate smooth, normalized-BV and selector summands. The hard cone and lower closeness give g<=G_0. The smooth term gains D_L/L; aggregate BV costs D_L^2; and a selector change is impossible for large L because one selected prime would lie in the fixed divisor set of g while the two distinct selected primes have logarithmic gap at most K_sel L^(-1/2). Bounded shells are absolutely safe. Thus the raw D_L sum_kappa(1+L/kappa)^2<<D_L L^2 capacity becomes D_L^2 L X^epsilon<=4L^2X^epsilon. After exact coordinatewise physical masking and replay of the accepted safe projectors, |R_core,out^sigma(P_cc W)|+|R_open,out^sigma(P_cc W)|<<_(B,C_0,K_sel,epsilon)L^2X^epsilon, where the open packets are kappa<D_L and min(Y,D_L)>H_B \mathfrak m kappa. The exact physical complement is P_boundary(lit) dotcup P_sf dotcup P_gf. The formal four-corner rectangle has the alternating table on its cross-coprime sign sector but forces physical kappa=1 and cannot cover 2<=kappa<D_L; a sharp ratio face aligned with g can retain D_L L^2 capacity. This is a route no-go, not literal lower mass or a disproof of complete P2. This node proves no complete P2, P1, complete original t=1 or t>=2 range, owner, parent, endpoint theorem, bridge, target, or exponent.
